program.section_heading: Infant & Toddler Studies Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Integrate and demonstrate knowledge of the needs, characteristics, and multiple influences that support optimal development in all areas for children from birth through 2½ years of age.

Promote partnerships between programs, teachers, families, and communities applying ethical standards and culturally sensitive professional behavior to support the development of infants and toddlers.
Design, implement, and evaluate developmentally appropriate environments, curriculum, and interactions between teachers and infants/toddlers, while applying the skills of observation and assessment.

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CH DEV 001, 010, 030, 031, 034); these correspond to closed-list CH DEV 1, 10, 30, 31, 34.
CH DEV 011 (Child, Family, and Community) is required in the catalog but absent from the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
Hyphenated line-break artifacts in the outcomes (e.g., 'charac -teristics', 'develop -ment') were joined into single words.
The text following the certificate's course list belongs to the Dietetics/Nutrition/Family and Consumer Studies section and was not read for this award.
Career entry taken from the description: 'entry-level teacher position within private infant/toddler programs' / 'Infant/Toddler teachers'.
